Rina (CS): quick capture from Zenith onboarding: finance can't reconcile invoices without per-route breakdowns. They want a CSV export plus an example mapping to their chart of accounts before the next renewal.
Omar (PM): copy. level of effort?
Jules (Eng): simple export endpoint + scheduled job for daily dumps. estimate 5 dev-days + 2 QA days if only core columns.
Rina (CS): requested columns: project_id,route_id,route_display,model,env,tokens_in,tokens_out,token_cost,currency_code,period_start,period_end,customer_cost_center. Also need sample row mapping tokens->cost in EUR.
Clara (CS): we should offer both on-demand and scheduled; customer asked for SFTP drop too.
Jules (Eng): SFTP adds infra work. scope initial launch as on-demand + HTTP download, add SFTP as P2.
Omar (PM): prioritise export as P1 due to renewal risk. SFTP and GL-mapping doc as P2. Add enablement: 20-min finance walkthrough + one-pager.
NotifyBot: Created ticket CS-4981: "Zenith billing export" tags=[billing,export,renewal-risk].
Rina (CS): I'll prepare the one-pager and sample GL mapping. once spec lands, can we get a quick QA demo for the customer?
Jules (Eng): yes—request a demo build. I'll attach CSV header sample in the ticket.
Omar (PM): timeline: spec by Tue EOD, eng start Wed, beta by next week.
Clara (CS): noted. I'll schedule the walkthrough provisional window and loop in finance.
